g.text: Make group of files by name
First element is main file, others sidecars
Sends new/changed groups and groups whose
item is not Ready (new, Dirty, interrupted)
An unreadable subdirectory is skipped and recorded
As soon as it takes list of files
Better to merge exifreader with validator
To be able to check whole group in a row
the validator runs inside the exif step
The item may be deleted already (finalize ran
first: the chain is async) -> restored as Dirty
end of walk (after the last group is stored)
(not on cancel, missing root, empty root)
Files with CheckTime older than this run, under the root,
not under an unreadable directory, are gone:
